title: Consigned
summary: The last page of Morrow Vane's ledger is a consignment note: the vessel, sent by the Solmere road to Brine Cross, "freight paid at Tollhaven". Sister Ilse is sending you east to Tollhaven's harbourmistress.

steps.journal: Take the Solmere road out of the Reach and on through Solmere to the Tidemark. Cross the bridge at Brine Cross, go east to Tollhaven, find Hester Quaile.

objectives.label: Talk to Hester Quaile in Tollhaven

ready: You've found Hester Quaile at the Paid Toll's door. Show her Ilse's copy of the ledger's last page.
done: Someone paid Hester's freight on a crate that never touched her quay. She has worse trouble on the quays at night.
